selectLanguageDescription: Dooro luqadda loo isticmaali doono habka rakibaadda iyo luqadda caadiga ah ee webka.
verifyRequirementsDescription: Hubi in deegaanka serverkaaga ay buuxin baahiyaha lagu maamulayo HAX.
allRequirementsMet: Dhammaan baahiyaha waa la buuxshay. Waxaad sii wadi kartaa talaabadan xigta.
configureSystemDescription: Deji akoonka maamulaha ee webka HAX cusub.
passwordHelp: Ka daa meel maran si uu si toos ah u abuurmo furaha amaan ah, ama geli 10+ xaraf oo ay ku jiraan ugu yaraan xaraf kaliya iyo tiro kaliya.
installationComplete: Rakibaadda waa la dhammeeyay! Halkan waxaa ku yaalla aqoonsiyahaaga.
saveCredentialsWarning: Muhiim: Aqoonsiyahan hadda kaydi. Kani waa markii kaliya ee la soo bandhigi doono.
languageHelp: Qor magac, magaca asalka ah ama koodh.
usernameHelp: Xarfo, tirooyin, dhibic, jiitin iyo underscore.
versionAfterSignIn: Nooca HAXcms iyo waddooyinka buuxa ee server-ka waxay ka muuqdaan system admin markaad gasho.
foreverFiles: Goobahaagu waa faylal caadi ah oo ku jira _sites, oo lagula socdo git maalinta ugu horreysa.
foreverStandards: Waxaa lagu dhisay heerarka webka, sidaas darteed waxa aad samayso way sii shaqaynayaan marka HAXcms la cusboonaysiiyo.
foreverPortable: Goob meel kasta u qaado: waxay ku shaqaysaa HAXcms ee PHP ama Node, ama faylal static ah.
foreverPillar: Waara: loo dhisay inuu waaro, khafiif ku ah meeraha.
tvArtCredit: Farshaxanka Future Traveler ee haxtheweb/art. TV-gu isku si ayuu ugu eg yahay iftiinka iyo mugdiga.
shortcutMainAction: Samee ficilka ugu muhiimsan ee tallaabada
padB: B: dib u qaado block-ii ugu dambeeyay
padNote: HAX Blocks ee kanaalka 2: la tartan saddex tartame si aad u hesho HAX blocks. A wuu qabtaa (ama wuu garaacaa tartame kuu dhow), B mid ayuu dib u qaadaa, Select wuxuu dib u habeeyaa dagaalyahankaaga, Start wuu daabacaa. Kiiboodhkaaguna wuu shaqeeyaa: fallaadhaha, A iyo B waxay iftiiminayaan badhanka ay riixaan.
tipDifferenceTitle: Farqiga HAX: waxa aad samayso way sii shaqaynayaan
tipDifference: Boggaggaagu waa HTML heerka webka ah oo ku jira faylal caadi ah oo aad leedahay, lagula socdo git. Ku dhowaad goob kasta oo lagu dhisay HAX tan iyo 2020 ilaa maanta way shaqaysaa, goobna waxay u guurtaa HAXcms ee PHP, Node ama martigelin static ah sida ay tahay. Loo dhisay inuu waaro, khafiif ku ah meeraha.
tipFilesTitle: Keen faylashaada oo ka dhig HAX
tipFiles: Rakibka kadib, Soo geli ee dashboard-ka ayaa kuwan u beddelaya goob HAX ah oo aad wax ka beddeli karto, dib u isticmaali karto oo meel kasta u qaadan karto.
tipSitesTitle: Soo guuri goob web oo dhan
tipSites: Soo geli ku tilmaan cinwaanka goobta, bogaggeeduna waxay u soo galayaan sida bogag iyo blocks HAX.
tipBooksTitle: Buugaagta iyo dukumentiyadana way soo galaan
tipBooks: Buugaag furan iyo repo-yada docs-as-code waxay noqdaan goob HAX ah oo qorshahoodu dhammaystiran yahay.
tipPasswordTitle: Furahaaga sirta ah hal mar ayuu muuqdaa
tipPassword: Tallaabada ugu dambeysa waxay hal mar muujinaysaa galitaankaaga cusub. Ku kaydi maareeye furayaal sir ah ka hor intaadan bilaabin HAXcms.
